## Data Profile SQL

```sql
WITH monthly_rev AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."orders.order_date" AS "order_date",
    _stage_inner."orders.rev" AS "rev"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date) AS "orders.order_date",
      CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.rev"
    FROM orders AS orders
    GROUP BY
      DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date)
  ) AS _stage_inner
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "monthly_rev._count",
  COUNT(DISTINCT monthly_rev.order_date) AS "monthly_rev.order_date_count_distinct",
  CAST(AVG(monthly_rev.rev) AS DOUBLE) AS "monthly_rev.rev_avg"
FROM monthly_rev AS monthly_rev
LIMIT 0
```

args.message: Revenue from monthly_rev (sum of order amounts) for each month of Q1 2025, split by customer region. Orders were left-joined to customers and then to regions, so orders without a known region would have shown up as a null group. None did: in every month the four regions add up exactly to the monthly_rev total (Jan 10070.12, Feb 8920.94, Mar 9816.20).
